ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
A simple crane is shown in the below diagram, consisted of light rods with length $1 \mathrm{~m}$ and $\sqrt{2} \mathrm{~m}$. The end of the crane is supporting a $5 \mathrm{kN}$ object. Point $B$ is known as a "pin." It is attached to the main body and can exert both a vertical and horizontal force. Point $A$ is known as a "roller" and can only exert vertical forces. Rods can only be in pure compression or pure tension.
<image_1>

In $\mathrm{kN}$, what is the force experienced by the rod $C D$ ? Express a positive number if the member is in tension and a negative number if it is in compression.

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: the figure shows a plane truss crane composed of horizontal, vertical, and 45-degree diagonal members. On the right side is a vertical tower frame one 1 m panel wide; the bottom left support is roller A, the bottom right support is pin support B, and A and B are separated by one 1 m panel width. Adjacent joints C and D are marked on the right vertical side, and member CD is the vertical member between them. A 5 kN weight is suspended at the end of the left boom, and its line of action is located two 1 m panel widths to the left of the vertical line through A. Reasoning: first take equilibrium of the entire truss. B_x=0, because the external load has no horizontal component. Taking moments about point A, the 5 kN load at 2 m to the left of A produces a 10 kN·m moment, and B_y at 1 m to the right of A balances it, so B_y=-10 kN, that is, the vertical reaction at B is 10 kN downward. Vertical force equilibrium gives A_y+B_y-5=0, therefore A_y=15 kN. By the method of joints from bottom to top. At joint B, B_y is 10 kN downward, and the horizontal reaction is 0, so the bottom horizontal member AB is a zero-force member, and the right bottom vertical member must pull joint B upward, hence that vertical member is in 10 kN tension. At joint A, AB is 0, and horizontal equilibrium makes the bottom diagonal member a zero-force member, while the vertical member bears 15 kN compression. Continuing upward, the 10 kN tension in the right vertical member is transmitted level by level; the corresponding horizontal member provides no vertical component, and the diagonal member entering joint D is a zero-force member. At joint D, the lower right vertical member pulls downward on joint D with 10 kN, the diagonal member is 0, and the horizontal member has no vertical component, therefore member CD must pull upward on joint D with 10 kN to satisfy vertical equilibrium. Member CD is in tension, and tension is taken as positive according to the problem.

raw_record.question_text:
A simple crane is shown in the diagram, consisting of light rods with length $1 \mathrm{~m}$ and $\sqrt{2} \mathrm{~m}$. The end of the crane is supporting a $5 \mathrm{kN}$ object. Point $B$ is known as a pin; it is attached to the main body and can exert both a vertical and horizontal force. Point $A$ is known as a roller and can only exert vertical forces. Rods can only be in pure compression or pure tension.

In $\mathrm{kN}$, what is the force experienced by the rod $CD$? Express a positive number if the member is in tension and a negative number if it is in compression.

method.method_draft: First read the diagram as a pin-jointed truss made from square 1 m panels with 45-degree diagonals of length sqrt(2). The load hangs from the left end of the upper boom, visually two 1 m panel widths to the left of the A vertical line; A is the lower-left support of the tower and B is the lower-right support, separated by 1 m. C and D are consecutive joints on the right vertical tower, with CD the vertical member between them. Use whole-truss equilibrium first: with only a 5 kN downward load and vertical reactions at A and B, take moments about A to get B_y = -10 kN, then vertical force balance gives A_y = 15 kN, and B_x = 0. Then use the method of joints from the bottom upward. At joint B, solve AB = 0 and the right-bottom vertical member = 10 kN tension. At joint A, the bottom diagonal is zero and the left-bottom vertical is 15 kN compression. At the next right joint above B, the vertical force balance transmits 10 kN tension upward to the next right vertical member, while the horizontal member is zero. At the adjacent left joint, the diagonal into D is zero and the left vertical remains compression. Finally at joint D, the lower right vertical member is already known to pull downward with 10 kN and the diagonal into D is zero, so vertical equilibrium requires member CD to pull upward with 10 kN. By the stated sign convention, report +10.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是由水平、竖直和45度斜杆组成的平面桁架式起重机。右侧是一列1 m宽的竖向塔架，底部左支座为A滚轮，底部右支座为B铰支座，A与B相距一个1 m面板宽度。右侧竖直边上标有相邻节点C和D，杆CD是它们之间的竖直杆。左侧吊臂端部悬挂5 kN重物，其作用线位于A竖直线左侧两个1 m面板宽度处。
推理：先对整个桁架取平衡。B_x=0，因为外载无水平分量。对A点取矩，5 kN载荷在A左侧2 m处产生10 kN·m力矩，B_y在A右侧1 m处平衡它，所以B_y=-10 kN，即B处竖向反力向下10 kN。竖向力平衡给A_y+B_y-5=0，因此A_y=15 kN。
按节点法自下而上。节点B处，B_y向下10 kN，水平反力为0，所以底部水平杆AB为0力杆，右侧底部竖直杆必须向上拉节点B，故该竖直杆受10 kN拉力。节点A处，AB为0，水平平衡使底部斜杆为0力杆，竖向杆承担15 kN压力。继续向上，右侧竖直杆中的10 kN拉力逐级传递；相应水平杆不提供竖向分量，进入D节点的斜杆为0力杆。到节点D时，下方右竖杆对D节点向下拉10 kN，斜杆为0，水平杆无竖向分量，因此杆CD必须对D节点向上拉10 kN以满足竖向平衡。杆CD为拉力，按题目拉力取正。

method.method_draft: First read the diagram as a square-panel crane truss: A and B are the two bottom supports one panel apart, the 5 kN load is hung at the left boom end two panel widths left of A, and CD is the right-side vertical member between the labeled joints C and D. From the full truss, compute reactions: moment about A gives B_y = -10 kN because the 5 kN load is 2 m left of A and B is 1 m right of A; then A_y = 15 kN from vertical equilibrium and B_x = 0 from horizontal equilibrium. Next use a method-of-sections cut through exactly three lower members: the left tower vertical member just above the lower-left joint, the horizontal member entering D from the left, and the target vertical member CD. Isolate the bottom portion containing A, B, the lower right verticals, and joint D. Take moments about D to eliminate the cut forces in CD and the horizontal member through D; this solves the cut left vertical member as 15 kN compression. Use horizontal equilibrium of the cut free body to show the cut horizontal member at D is zero. Then vertical equilibrium of the cut free body gives 15 - 10 - 15 + F_CD = 0, so F_CD = 10 kN. Since the assumed section force in CD is tensile, the signed answer is +10.
method.CoT_raw:
先描述图像：图中是一个由方形面板和对角杆组成的平面桁架起重机。底部左侧支座标为 A，画成滚轮；底部右侧支座标为 B，画成铰支座。右侧竖直边上有相邻的关节点 C 和 D，杆 CD 是它们之间的右侧竖直杆。左侧伸出的吊臂末端挂有 5 kN 竖直向下的载荷。图中面板可按 1 m 的水平/竖直杆和 sqrt(2) m 的斜杆理解。

推理：先对整个桁架求支座反力。以 A 点取矩，5 kN 载荷位于 A 左侧 2 m，B 位于 A 右侧 1 m，因此力矩平衡给出 5*2 + B_y*1 = 0，所以 B_y = -10 kN，即 B 对桁架的竖直反力向下。竖直力平衡为 A_y + B_y - 5 = 0，故 A_y = 15 kN。水平外力平衡给 B_x = 0。

按指定截面法，截开下部三个构件：左侧竖直构件、通向 D 的水平构件、目标杆 CD，并取包含 A、B、D 及下部右侧竖杆的下半部分为自由体。对 D 点取矩时，CD 的截面力和通过 D 的水平截面力都过 D 点而不产生力矩；由力矩平衡，左侧竖直截面力必须与 A_y = 15 kN 的力矩相抵，因此该左侧竖直杆在下部自由体上表现为 15 kN 向下作用，即按该假定为 15 kN 压缩。水平方向平衡中 B_x = 0，所以 D 处水平截面力为 0。最后对下部自由体作竖直力平衡，并取 CD 拉力在下部自由体上向上为正：15 - 10 - 15 + F_CD = 0，得到 F_CD = 10 kN。由于该方向对应杆 CD 受拉，按题目约定取正号。

planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use global rigid-body equilibrium for reactions, then apply method of sections: cut at most three unknown member forces, choose a moment center to eliminate concurrent/collinear cut forces, and finish with planar force equilibrium.

solver_metadata.cot_raw:
先描述图像：图中是一个由方形面板和对角杆组成的平面桁架起重机。底部左侧支座标为 A，画成滚轮；底部右侧支座标为 B，画成铰支座。右侧竖直边上有相邻的关节点 C 和 D，杆 CD 是它们之间的右侧竖直杆。左侧伸出的吊臂末端挂有 5 kN 竖直向下的载荷。图中面板可按 1 m 的水平/竖直杆和 sqrt(2) m 的斜杆理解。

推理：先对整个桁架求支座反力。以 A 点取矩，5 kN 载荷位于 A 左侧 2 m，B 位于 A 右侧 1 m，因此力矩平衡给出 5*2 + B_y*1 = 0，所以 B_y = -10 kN，即 B 对桁架的竖直反力向下。竖直力平衡为 A_y + B_y - 5 = 0，故 A_y = 15 kN。水平外力平衡给 B_x = 0。

按指定截面法，截开下部三个构件：左侧竖直构件、通向 D 的水平构件、目标杆 CD，并取包含 A、B、D 及下部右侧竖杆的下半部分为自由体。对 D 点取矩时，CD 的截面力和通过 D 的水平截面力都过 D 点而不产生力矩；由力矩平衡，左侧竖直截面力必须与 A_y = 15 kN 的力矩相抵，因此该左侧竖直杆在下部自由体上表现为 15 kN 向下作用，即按该假定为 15 kN 压缩。水平方向平衡中 B_x = 0，所以 D 处水平截面力为 0。最后对下部自由体作竖直力平衡，并取 CD 拉力在下部自由体上向上为正：15 - 10 - 15 + F_CD = 0，得到 F_CD = 10 kN。由于该方向对应杆 CD 受拉，按题目约定取正号。

verify_reports.critic_suggestions: 推理过程与图像、标准答案和指定方法基本一致。图像描述先于推理，符合多模态顺序要求；支座类型、载荷位置、C/D 所在右侧竖杆、A 与 B 的相对位置等视觉信息均可由图中验证。整体反力计算、截面选择、取矩点 D、水平平衡与竖直平衡步骤均与方法草稿一致，最终得到 CD 受拉 10 kN，与标准答案一致。无需实质性修改。

raw_record.original_question:
A simple crane is shown in the diagram, consisting of light rods with length $1 \mathrm{~m}$ and $\sqrt{2} \mathrm{~m}$. The end of the crane is supporting a $5 \mathrm{kN}$ object. Point $B$ is known as a pin; it is attached to the main body and can exert both a vertical and horizontal force. Point $A$ is known as a roller and can only exert vertical forces. Rods can only be in pure compression or pure tension.

In $\mathrm{kN}$, what is the force experienced by the rod $CD$? Express a positive number if the member is in tension and a negative number if it is in compression.
raw_record.final_cot:
Image description: the figure shows a plane truss crane composed of horizontal, vertical, and 45-degree diagonal members. On the right side is a vertical tower frame one 1 m panel wide; the bottom left support is roller A, the bottom right support is pin support B, and A and B are separated by one 1 m panel width. Adjacent joints C and D are marked on the right vertical side, and member CD is the vertical member between them. A 5 kN weight is suspended at the end of the left boom, and its line of action is located two 1 m panel widths to the left of the vertical line through A.
Reasoning: first take equilibrium of the entire truss. B_x=0, because the external load has no horizontal component. Taking moments about point A, the 5 kN load at 2 m to the left of A produces a 10 kN·m moment, and B_y at 1 m to the right of A balances it, so B_y=-10 kN, that is, the vertical reaction at B is 10 kN downward. Vertical force equilibrium gives A_y+B_y-5=0, therefore A_y=15 kN.
By the method of joints from bottom to top. At joint B, B_y is 10 kN downward, and the horizontal reaction is 0, so the bottom horizontal member AB is a zero-force member, and the right bottom vertical member must pull joint B upward, hence that vertical member is in 10 kN tension. At joint A, AB is 0, and horizontal equilibrium makes the bottom diagonal member a zero-force member, while the vertical member bears 15 kN compression. Continuing upward, the 10 kN tension in the right vertical member is transmitted level by level; the corresponding horizontal member provides no vertical component, and the diagonal member entering joint D is a zero-force member. At joint D, the lower right vertical member pulls downward on joint D with 10 kN, the diagonal member is 0, and the horizontal member has no vertical component, therefore member CD must pull upward on joint D with 10 kN to satisfy vertical equilibrium. Member CD is in tension, and tension is taken as positive according to the problem.

critic_agent_reviews.critic_suggestions: 整体推理与标准答案和方法草稿一致，且满足“先描述图像，再推理”的顺序。建议小幅修订：在最后的节点D分析中，若图中D节点实际只连接竖直杆和水平杆，应避免说“进入D节点的斜杆为0”，可改为“与D相关的斜杆已由相邻节点平衡判定为零或不在D点提供竖向分量”；并在结尾显式写出最终答案为“+10 kN”。
推理过程与图像、标准答案和指定方法基本一致。图像描述先于推理，符合多模态顺序要求；支座类型、载荷位置、C/D 所在右侧竖杆、A 与 B 的相对位置等视觉信息均可由图中验证。整体反力计算、截面选择、取矩点 D、水平平衡与竖直平衡步骤均与方法草稿一致，最终得到 CD 受拉 10 kN，与标准答案一致。无需实质性修改。
